_about: Battle replay record (List 20 #187). A replay is an input log over a seeded simulation: setup + #10's committed turn records + the seed stream. Playback re-runs RESOLUTION and writes nothing. Records are append-only, seated beside #126's Hall of Fame. This fragment instances no replay.

outcome.note: the outcome the live battle recorded; playback must reproduce it or the battle's resolution drew unseeded randomness (a determinism defect, #187)

playback.writes: NOTHING — gain (#177), honours (#104), tallies (#97), dex (#14) and streaks (#86) fired at the live battle and never re-fire

retention: OPEN — no canon capacity; the slot ships with the question

seed.rule: every draw in resolution (variance, accuracy, #18 tie-breaks, #94 generation) draws from this recorded stream — #94's discipline extended to resolution

parties.snapshot: the battle-relevant facts resolution read (level, variance, deviations, held item) — snapshotted per #126's logic, because the living record may later change or be released

commands.command: #10 COMMIT shape — the command exactly as committed
